title: Wedding Budget Burn-Down
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:budget
| stats sum(committed) as committed, sum(paid) as paid, max(total_budget) as budget
| eval remaining=budget-committed, over_under=budget-committed
description: Tracks committed and paid spend against your total wedding budget so you always know how much is left.
value: Weddings are notorious for budget creep; a live burn-down keeps decisions grounded in what you can afford.
implementation: Ingest budget lines into `index=personal`; sum committed and paid against the total.
visualization: Bar chart of budget versus committed and paid.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up what you have promised and paid against your wedding budget, so you always know what is left.
